summary: Tested 3 assertions: all 3 passed. VAL-CMP-001: Bounded[Req,Upd] runtime has 15 test cases covering all 7 required behaviors (configurable buffer, idempotent Stop, ErrStopped sentinel, Updates closed once, context cancellation, goroutine leak check, concurrent enqueue+stop). All pass with -race -count=50. VAL-CMP-002: Full tui test suite passes with -race; git diff confirms existing runtime test files were only added (not modified). VAL-CMP-003: All 5 entity types exist (Agent, AgentNode, Room, RoomMessage, EventRow), all 18 EntryKind constants present, ParseEntryKind legacy mapper tested with 7 unit tests covering all values, case-insensitivity, unknown handling, and round-trip.
